verdict.rationale: Square ships an in-product 'Square AI' assistant that answers natural-language questions over seller data, plus an official MCP server (local and hosted, OAuth-gated) that lets AI agents/tools operate the Square API via natural-language-driven agent workflows. However, Square AI is described only as Beta and insight/reporting focused, not a full natural-language command interface for all operations, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence of reliability or breadth of NL command coverage. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of Square AI's NL command scope, evidence of NL commands covering write/transactional operations (not just insights), and confirmation the MCP server's NL-driven flows are broadly relied upon in production rather than beta/dev tooling.
